{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify all premises
assert 'severe' in df['severity'].unique(), "Severity 'severe' not found in data"
assert len(df[df['severity'] == 'severe']) > 0, "No patients with severe disease found"
assert 'biomarker_baseline' in df.columns, "Column 'biomarker_baseline' not found"

# Deduplicate on patient_id: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for severe patients
df_severe_dedup = df_dedup[df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = df_severe_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] == -999
num_sentinels = sentinel_mask.sum()

# Exclude rows with sentinel values
valid_baseline_dedup = df_severe_dedup[~sentinel_mask]

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = valid_baseline_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of unique patients with SEVERE disease: {len(valid_baseline_dedup)}")
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in baseline: {num_sentinels}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")"}
